_comment: Host init/teardown CI golden (Wormhole: wh_n300_civ2 2-chip + wh_llmbox_perf 8-chip T3K + wh_galaxy_perf 32-chip 6U galaxy). BRING-UP: real_time values are Blackhole-derived ESTIMATES (order-of-magnitude, from a local Blackhole capture; mesh_N scaled ~N x single_chip) used as realistic placeholders until a real Wormhole run is captured; they are NOT gated yet. The runtime_perf_host_init_teardown CI job runs compare_host_init_teardown_ci.py with --ignore-times, which for this benchmark validates structure only (no errored benchmarks) and treats topology-set mismatches as advisories, since the topology axis is enumerated from the attached cluster. Arm the gate by replacing these with a real benchmark_out JSON captured on the SKU, then drop --ignore-times. Metric = host-side real_time (ns) of the min aggregate: BM_host_init = MeshDevice open, BM_host_teardown = MeshDevice close. wh_n300_civ2 has two chips, so its sweep is single_chip (unit mesh) + mesh_2; wh_llmbox_perf (T3K, 8 chips) adds mesh_4 + mesh_8; wh_galaxy_perf (6U galaxy, 32 chips) adds mesh_16 + mesh_32 (full system mesh). Per-SKU topology-set differences are expected and treated as advisories under --ignore-times.
